summary: ENDRA Life Sciences filed an 8-K to report a private placement of 578,387 shares (or pre-funded warrants) and warrants to purchase up to 1,156,774 shares at $6.57 per combined unit, for gross proceeds of ~$3.8M. Lucid Capital Markets acted as sole placement agent. Proceeds are for working capital. The filing is a routine capital-raising agreement, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign. No special-situation dynamics are present; the transaction is a standard PIPE offering with no change of control, tender, or strategic review involved.
